title: "An approach to computing and sustainability inspired from permaculture" by Devine Lu Linvega
summary: Devine Lu Linvega of Hundred Rabbits talks about low-power, offline computing, esoteric languages and the Uxn virtual machine, informed by years of sailing the Pacific. The talk frames computing sustainability through a permaculture lens.
why: Praised as a standout, non-standard Strange Loop talk explaining the reasoning behind Uxn and resilient computing.

quote.text: Devine had a great talk about the "why" of Uxn at Strange Loop last year
